images.title: Pairs with none left, pairs with one left
images.purpose: Show that an even number pairs up with none left and an odd number has one left over.
images.composition: 14 counters in 7 pairs tagged even, and 15 counters in 7 pairs with one ringed counter tagged odd.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two groups of counters in pairs. LEFT GROUP: 7 counters in a top row at y 250 to 310 starting at x 100, and 7 counters in a bottom row at y 325 to 385 starting at x 100, each counter a circle of 60 px diameter filled teal #0072B2, outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px, with 15 px between neighbours; every counter of the bottom row sits directly under a counter of the top row, so there are 7 pairs and no counter is left over (x 100 to 610). The number 14 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (80 px) is centred above it at x 355, y 190, and the tag even in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (56 px) below it at x 355, y 470. RIGHT GROUP: 8 counters in a top row at y 250 to 310 starting at x 780, and 7 counters in a bottom row at y 325 to 385 starting at x 780, each counter a circle of 60 px diameter filled teal #0072B2, outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px, with 15 px between neighbours; the first 7 counters of the top row have a partner below them (7 pairs) and the eighth counter of the top row (x 1305 to 1365) has none, so it is circled by an amber #E69F00 ring (6 px, 80 px diameter). The number 15 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (80 px) is centred above it at x 1072, y 190 and the tag odd in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (56 px) below it at x 1072, y 470. Under the left group, centred at x 355, y 540, the text 7 pairs in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px); under the right group, centred at x 1072, y 540, the text 7 pairs, and at x 1335, y 610 the text 1 left over in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than one ringed counter
a counter count other than 14 and 15
images.takeaway: Even means pairs with none left over, odd means one left over.
images.description: Two groups of counters: 14 in 7 pairs, even, and 15 in 7 pairs with 1 left over, odd.
images.context: Concept image for Even and Odd by Pairing, using the example's own numbers (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Count the pairs and look for a ringed counter. The slip to watch: thinking a number ending in 0 is neither.

image_decisions.why: The ringed counter is the mathematics of odd.
